name: Gulf Crossing Pipeline / Panda Power Lateral
researcher_notes: EIA release August 2026, sheet Historical Projects (1996-2024), Excel row 769: Panda Power Lateral Project, operator Gulf Crossing Pipeline, type Lateral, Completed 30 May 2014, Texas, cost 26.3 million dollars, 16.5 miles, 125 MMcf/d added capacity, 16 inch, interstate, FERC docket CP13-64. The consolidator note's 26.6 km is the mile figure converted; the sheet value stays 16.5 mi. This is not part of existing P0196 (Gulf Crossing, 353 mi, Sherman to Perryville, 42 inch) or P5939 (Gulf South Mississippi Loop), so it is a separate row in the expansion shape with PipelineName set to the parent's name. It passes the 25 km length rule by a small margin (16.5 mi is about 26.6 km). Only one source (EIA, one origin). No second source could be loaded: web search was unavailable this session, and the FERC and Federal Register fetches failed. Endpoints within Texas are not stated in the EIA sheet, so start and end location are left blank; the lateral is believed to serve the Panda Sherman power plant near Sherman, Texas, but that is unconfirmed. Owner not staged: EIA names Gulf Crossing Pipeline as operator, and the parent row P0196 lists Boardwalk Pipeline Partners and Loews Corp, but no loaded source states ownership of this lateral. A person should pair this with the FERC order for CP13-64 and add endpoints. No route researched; RouteType and RouteAccuracy left for the routes leg. Added step note: the project is completed, so the concrete-step test is met.
